description: This file defines a Drupal behavior for managing toolbar popovers, including functions for opening, closing, toggling, and event handling related to popover UI interactions.

methods.name: attach
methods.description: Attaches popover behavior to elements within the given context.

methods.name: toggleState
methods.description: Toggles the popover's expanded/collapsed state and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: isPopoverHoverOrFocus
methods.description: Checks if the popover is currently hovered or focused.

methods.name: delayedClose
methods.description: Closes the popover after a delay if not hovered or focused.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Sets event listeners to open the popover on hover or focus.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Removes event listeners and collapses the popover.
